title: PSALM 30:5 – JOY COMES IN THE MORNING – RECEIVE IT NOW
text: Glory, glory, glory. Don't rush this moment. Something about this atmosphere is different. I didn't come with an agenda tonight. I came with a burden and the burden is simple. Some of you have survived the night, but you did not recover from it. You made it through, but you did not come out rejoicing. That ends today. If you are connected to this broadcast, quickly share it. Someone's joy is tied to your obedience. Lift your voice gently and say, "Father, I am here." Yes. Now worship him. Lord, you are faithful. You are consistent. You are righteous. You kept us when we could not keep ourselves. You guarded us when we were vulnerable. You defended us in silence. Thank you. We bless you for the night you carried us through. We bless you for the breath in our lungs. We bless you for another morning. You are holy. You are mighty. You are dependable. Take the glory. Somebody whisper, "You are enough. You are enough. When answers delay, you are enough when strength fails. You are enough. When hope seems thin, we worship you. Let the worship rise slow, deep, intentional. We adore you, Jesus. We honor you, spirit of the living God. We magnify you, eternal father. Now listen, there are mornings that come with news and there are mornings that come with verdicts. This morning is not reporting what the night did. This morning is overruling it. Psalm 30 5 says, "For his anger is but for a moment. His favor is for life. Weeping may endure for a night, but joy comes in the morning." This is not comfort language. This is spiritual law. Weeping has permission but only for the night. Joy has authority and it owns the morning. Meaning when morning comes, joy has the legal right to appear. But listen carefully, joy does not come automatically. It comes by alignment. That is why many wake up alive but joyless. This morning alignment is restored. Psalm 16 11 says in your presence is fullness of joy not partial joy not borrow joy fullness. So joy is not produced by circumstances. Joy is released by presence and presence is here. Now lift your hands again. Father in the name of Jesus we align ourselves with the authority of the morning. Every residue of the night we shake it off now. Every sorrow that followed us from yesterday, we release it now in the name of Jesus. Now hear this. Joy is not laughter. Joy is strength. Nehemiah 8 10 says the joy of the Lord is your strength. Meaning where joy is absent, weakness increases. That is why some of you have been tired for no reason. It wasn't stress. It was stolen joy. But it is restored now. Lift your voice and declare, "My joy is restored." Again with authority, "My joy is restored." Now pray. Every spirit assigned to drain my joy, lose your hold now. Every heaviness sitting on my soul, lift now. Every silent sadness, break now in the name of Jesus. I decree lightness of spirit. Isaiah 61:3 says to give them beauty for ashes, the oil of joy for mourning, the garment of praise for the spirit of heaviness. Garments can be changed. So I decree every garment of heaviness off now. Wear joy, wear praise, wear hope again. I sense something breaking. There is a woman here. Your name is Naomi. You have smiled publicly but cried privately. The Lord says this morning I exchange your sorrow. Receive it now. Now tongues rise softly at first. Lashandra. Yes, joy is flowing. Now listen carefully. Joy is also a weapon. Habacook 3 17 to18 says, "Though the fig tree may not blossom, yet I will rejoice in the Lord." Meaning joy can be activated before results appear. So this morning, joy is not a response. Joy is a declaration. Lift your hands. Father, we choose joy not because everything is perfect. But because you are faithful, we receive joy now. We enforce joy now. We defend joy now. In the name of Jesus, I decree this morning will not be heavy. This week will not be sorrowful. This season will not be bitter. Joy has come and it will stay. Amen. Amen. Amen. I sense a quiet fire moving now. This is not the fire that makes noise. This is the fire that changes internal structures. Listen carefully. There are people here whose problem is not that they cry. It is that they have forgotten how to rejoice. Not because they are ungrateful but because life trained them to expect disappointment. But hear me by the spirit of God. Joy is not a personality trait. Joy is a spiritual entitlement. And entitlement is enforced, not begged for. Psalm 118 15 says, "The voice of rejoicing and salvation is in the tense of the righteous." Meaning when righteousness is present, rejoicing has a legal right to be heard. So if you are born again, joy is not optional. Now lift your voice. Father, by the authority of the finished work of Christ, I reclaim the joy that belongs to me, every joy stolen by trauma, restore it now. Every joy stolen by disappointment, restore it now. Every joy stolen by prolonged waiting, restore it now in the name of Jesus. Now listen, there is a kind of joy that is emotional and there is a kind of joy that is governmental. Governmental joy does not change when circumstances change. It stays because it is rooted in who God is, not what happens. Romans 14 17 says, "For the kingdom of God is not eating and drinking, but righteousness and peace and joy in the Holy Spirit." So joy is not just a feeling. Joy is a kingdom signature. When joy returns, the kingdom has reasserted itself. Now pray. Every power that has challenged God's rule in my emotions, be dethroned now. Every voice that keeps replaying old pain, be silenced now. Every imagination that fuels sadness, collapse now in the name of Jesus. I decree emotional restoration. Psalm 23:3 says, "He restores my soul, not your finances first, not your reputation first. your soul because if your soul is restored, everything else follows. I see a man here. Your name is David. You've been carrying responsibility beyond your strength. The Lord says, "I restore your inner joy. You will laugh again. Receive it now. Now tongues rise stronger. Many satellite palushia raashandiba caliva. Yes, joy is breaking layers. Now listen, some of you think joy will come after breakthrough. But the spirit of God is correcting that mindset. Now joy comes before manifestation. Psalm 126:es 2 says then our mouth was filled with laughter and our tongue with singing then meaning after captivity turned but verse one says when the Lord brought back the captivity of Zion we were like those who dream joy preceded full awareness meaning joy often arrives before your mind catches up so don't argue with joy when it comes Don't analyze it. Receive it. Lift your hands. Father, we receive joy now. Not tomorrow. Not after confirmation. Now we receive joy in our spirits. Joy in our minds. Joy in our bodies in the name of Jesus. Now we shift. Joy is also a signal to hell. When joy returns, hell knows it has lost leverage. Proverbs 17 22 says, "A merry heart does good like medicine, but a broken spirit dries the bones. Broken spirits empower sickness." So joy is a healing agent. Now pray for your body. Every sickness thriving in an atmosphere of heaviness, die now. Every pain fed by stress, release now. Every weakness sustained by sorrow be healed now in the name of Jesus. I decree healing. I decree vitality. I decree strength. Isaiah 40 31 says they that wait upon the Lord shall renew their strength. Waiting here does not mean delay. It means alignment. Your strength is renewed now. I see healing in knees. I see healing in the lower back. I see healing in the chest area. Someone just felt heat. That is the power of God. Now we go further. Joy also opens gates. Psalm 100 4 says, "Enter his gates with thanksgiving and his courts with praise." At what day? So if gates have been closed, check the posture. This morning gates are opening. Lift your voice. Every gate that refused me yesterday, open now. Every door that resisted me last season, open now. Every opportunity that hid from me, locate me now in the name of Jesus. I decree favor. I decree access. I decree acceleration. Now listen carefully. There is a woman here. Your name is Ruth. You've been faithful in obscurity. The Lord says joy is bringing you into visibility. Help us. We see you now. We seal this wave with authority. Lift both hands. Father, we thank you. We thank you because joy has come. We thank you because joy is staying. We decree that sorrow will not return. We decree that heaviness will not recycle. The night is over. The morning has spoken. Joy has come in Jesus mighty name. Amen. Amen. Amen. I feel a sudden stillness in the spirit. This is the stillness that comes before verdicts are announced. Listen carefully. There is a lie. Many believers were taught that joy is fragile. That joy depends on people. That joy depends on money. That joy depends on things going right. That is not Bible joy. Bible joy is indestructible because it is rooted in God's sovereignty. John 16 22 says, "You now therefore have sorrow, but I will see you again and your heart will rejoice and your joy no one will take from you." No one. Meaning joy can be contested but it cannot be stolen when it comes from God. This morning joy becomes untouchable. Lift your voice and declare slowly, "My joy is untouchable." Again, my joy is untouchable. You can now pray. Every hand that touched my joy unlawfully wither now. Every relationship that drained my joy lose influence now. Every season that trained me to expect pain expire now in the name of Jesus. I decree emotional freedom. Isaiah 12:3 says with joy you will draw water from the wells of salvation. Meaning joy gives you access to spiritual supply. If you have been dry, if prayer became mechanical, if worship became heavy, joy is the missing key. Now lift your hands. Father, refill spiritual wells. Let joy restore hunger. Let joy restore passion. Let joy restore prayer fire. In the name of Jesus, I sense a release. Someone here your name is Peter. You stop praying with expectancy. The Lord says joy has returned to your altar. Now tongues rise deeper. and Devra. Yes. Now listen carefully. Joy also confuses the enemy. Isaiah 54:14 says, "In righteousness you shall be established. You shall be far from oppression. Oppression feeds on fear and sorrow. When joy rises, oppression loses direction. That is why some attacks suddenly stop without explanation. This morning, oppression loses its map. Lift your voice. Every oppressive cycle in my life, break now. Every morning sadness without cause, leave now. Every heaviness assigned to slow me down be uprooted now. In the name of Jesus, I decree peace. Romans 15 says, "May the God of hope fill you with all joy and peace in believing." So joy and peace travel together. I decree peace in your mind, peace in your sleep, peace in your decisions. Now we enter destiny restoration. Joy is a destiny indicator. Proverbs 4 18 says, "The path of the just is like the shining sun that shines ever brighter onto the perfect day. If destiny is moving forward, joy increases." So stagnation attacks joy first. But today stagnation breaks. Lift your hands. Father, restore forward motion. Every destiny paused by discouragement, resume now. Every calling buried under sorrow, resurface now. Every gift silenced by disappointment, reactivate now in the name of Jesus. I see clarity returning. Someone, your name is Emmanuel. You lost confidence in your calling. The Lord says joy is restoring your conviction. Now we address family and relationships. Joy also heals atmospheres. Proverbs 15 says, "A merry heart makes a cheerful countenance." Meaning joy spreads. Lift your voice. Every atmosphere of tension in my home be healed now. Every silent conflict be resolved now. Every pattern of misunderstanding break now in the name of Jesus. I decree peace in families, peace in marriages, peace between parents and children. Now finances, joy attracts favor. Psalm 52 says, "For you, oh Lord, will bless the righteous. With favor you will surround him as with a shield." Favor responds to joy, not desperation. Lift your hands. Father, release favor. Favor in interviews, favor in applications, favor in negotiations. I decree money will not run from you. Opportunities will not bypass you. Now listen carefully. There is a woman here. Your name is Lydia. You have struggled financially despite diligence. The Lord says joy is opening your gates. Expect a shift. Now we seal again but not the final seal yet. Lift both hands. Father we thank you. Joy has become strength. Joy has become clarity. Joy has become momentum. We decree no return to sorrow. No relapse into heaviness. The night is closed. The morning is established. Joy has come in Jesus mighty name. Amen. Amen. Amen. Lift your hands again. I sense something very specific in the spirit right now. This is not loud. This is surgical. There are people connected to this service whose joy was not stolen suddenly. It was gradually leaked. Not by one tragedy, not by one loss, but by accumulated disappointments, small unanswered prayers, delayed expectations, quiet letdowns. And over time the soul learned to protect itself by lowering joy. But hear me by the spirit of God. Protection through numbness is not healing. And this morning God is restoring what you muted to survive. Psalm 42 11 says, "Why are you cast down, oh my soul, and why are you disqued within me? Hope in God." Notice David spoke to his soul. Meaning the soul can drift even when the spirit is alive. Now lift your voice. Father by the authority of your word we speak to our souls. Soul wake up. Soul realign. Soul receive joy again in the name of Jesus. Now pray this aggressively. Every emotional defense that shut down my joy come down now. Every internal vow that said don't expect too much be broken now. Every silent agreement with sadness expire now in the name of Jesus. I decree emotional openness I decree childlike faith restored. Matthew 18 3 says unless you are converted and become as little children you will by no means enter the kingdom. Children expect joy naturally. That expectation is returning. I send someone here. Your name is Andrew. You stopped celebrating small wins. The Lord says joy is recalibrating your perception. Now tongue slow deep sustained. Yes. Now listen carefully. Joy is also a prophetic announcement. When joy shows up, it declares that God has moved ahead of you. Psalm 126:es 5 says, "Those who sow in tears shall reap in joy." Meaning joy is not random. It is harvest language. So when joy comes, harvest is near. Lift your hands. Father, announce harvest. Harvest of prayers, harvest of patience, harvest of obedience. Let joy be the announcement in the name of Jesus. Now we enter time and virtue restoration. Joy returns what? Sorrow drained. Isaiah 61:7 says, "Instead of your shame, you shall have double honor. And instead of confusion, they shall rejoice." Notice rejoicing replaces confusion. So confusion breaks now. Lift your voice. Every mental confusion clear now. Every decision fatigue lift now. Every uncertainty resolve now in the name of Jesus. I decree clarity. I decree precision. I decree alignment. Someone here your name is Solomon. You've been torn between options. The Lord says joy is restoring certainty. Now we address spiritual altars. Some altars feed on sadness. Judges 6 25 says, "Take your father's altar and tear it down." Meaning inherited spiritual structures can sustain emotional bondage, but they fall now. Lift your voice. Every altar that feeds on sorrow in my lineage, catch fire now. Every ancestral pattern of depression, be uprooted now. Every inherited heaviness be terminated now in the name of Jesus. Fire, fire, fire. Now tongues stronger, authoritative tale zate palushia raotes and yes I feel released. Now we speak divine preservation. Joy protects longevity. Proverbs 3:16 says, "Length of days is in her right hand. Joy extends life." Lift your hands. Father preserve lives. No premature death. No sudden calamity, no tragic endings. I decree long life. I decree fulfillment of days. Psalm 91 16. Now listen. There is a woman here. Your name is Deborah. You feared that stress was shortening your life. The Lord says joy is healing you at the root. I feel a strong judicial anointing now. This is the kind of anointing that does not shout at problems. It issues verdicts. Listen carefully. Joy is not only restoration. Joy is evidence. When God restores joy, he is proving that the season of accusation has ended. Zephaniah 31 17 says, "The Lord your God in your midst, the mighty one will save. He will rejoice over you with gladness. He will quiet you with his love. He will rejoice over you with singing." Did you hear that? God rejoices over you. So when joy returns to you, it is heaven mirroring his posture toward you. Meaning heaven is no longer angry. Heaven is no longer silent. Heaven is celebrating you again. Now lift your voice. Father, if you rejoice over me, I receive joy without guilt. Every voice that says you don't deserve joy yet, be silenced now in the name of Jesus. Now pray. Every accusation against my destiny, answered now. Every voice of condemnation overruled now. Romans 8:1 says, "There is therefore now no condemnation to those who are in Christ Jesus." So joy is your legal right. Now listen, some of you were taught to associate joy with irresponsibility as though being joyful means you are ignoring reality. That is a lie. Joy is not denial. Joy is faith speaking ahead of manifestation. Hebrews 11:1 says, "Faith is the substance of things hoped for, the evidence of things not seen." Joy is one of faith's loudest evidences. So this morning, your joy is prophesying. Lift your hands. Father, let my joy prophesy my breakthrough. Let my joy announce my turnaround. Let my joy confuse my enemies in the name of Jesus. Now tongue steady strong. Sandor Rivera. Yes. Now we go into covenant breaking. Hear this. There are covenants of sorrow. Covenants of perpetual sadness. Covenants of things always go wrong. They are real, but they are illegal. Galatians 33 says, "Christ has redeemed us from the curse of the law, having become a cause for us." So no covenant of sorrow can survive redemption. Lift your voice. By the blood of Jesus, I break every covenant of sorrow in my life. Every agreement that ties my progress to pain broken now. Every oath that demands tears before testimony terminated now in the name of Jesus. I release the fire of God. Fire into covenants. Fire into altars. Fire into records. Let joy replace mourning. Now listen carefully. There is someone here, your name is Sarah. You have normalized sadness as maturity. The Lord says joy is not childish. It is kingdom. Receive it now. Now we address destiny retrieval. Joy often leaves when destiny is attacked. But when destiny is restored, joy comes back suddenly. Psalm 71 20 to 21 says, "You who have shown me great and severe troubles shall revive me again and bring me up again from the depths of the earth. You shall increase my greatness and comfort me on every side." Comfort here means restoration of joy. Lift your hands. Father, retrieve destinies. Every destiny buried by discouragement. Come alive now. Every calling postponed by sorrow, reactivate now. Every vision abandoned, return now in the name of Jesus. I decree divine revival of purpose. Now we move into family lines. Joy is generational. Psalm 112:2 says, "His descendants will be mighty on earth. The generation of the upright will be blessed. When parents lose joy, children inherit heaviness, but that chain breaks today. Lift your voice. Every generational pattern of sadness, end with me now. Every lineage where joy disappeared, be restored now in the name of Jesus. I decree laughter in families. I decree peace in homes. I decree celebration replacing silence. Now listen, there is a man here. Your name is Isaac. Your father was joyful. Then life broke him. The Lord says, "You will not repeat that story. Joy is preserved in you." Lift your hands one last time. I sense a strong presence of the spirit now. Not moving around but settling. This is how God ends matters. When God finishes a thing, he doesn't shout. He establishes. Listen carefully. Joy is not only something you receive. Joy is something God uses to mark the end of seasons. Psalm 30:5 says, "Again, weeping may endure for a night, but joy comes in the morning." Meaning, when joy comes, the night no longer has legal access. So, hear me by the spirit of God. Your night is over. Not metaphorically, spiritually. Every season where sorrow had permission, that permission has expired. Lift your voice and say, "My night is over." Again with authority. My night is over. Now pray. Every cycle that required pain before progress end now. Every pattern where joy was delayed, collapse now. Every demonic timetable built around my tears be destroyed now. In the name of Jesus, I decree finality. Ecclesiastes 7:8 says, "The end of a thing is better than its beginning." So I decree this ending is better. This conclusion is glorious. This turnaround is complete. Now listen, joy is also a seal. When God seals a season, he seals it with peace and joy. Romans 15 says, "Now may the God of hope fill you with all joy and peace in believing." So joy and peace are flowing now together. Lift your hands. Father, seal every victory. Seal emotional healing. Seal destiny restoration. Seal family peace. Seal financial recovery. Seal spiritual fire. Let no door open to sorrow. Let no residue of heaviness remain in the name of Jesus. Now I release angelic enforcement. Psalm 347 says, "The angel of the Lord encamps all around those who fear him and delivers them. I decree angels of joy, angels of celebration, angels of remembrance, angels of compensation, go ahead of God's people, clear paths, announce favor, preserve lives." Now hear this final word of knowledge. There are three people here, one named Janet. The Lord says you will laugh again and it will not be forced. One named Paul, the Lord says your testimony will shock those who watched you suffer. One named mercy, the Lord says what broke you will now bless you. Receive it now. We seal with victory tongues, not warfare tongues. Tongues of triumph shakarabosata lera kadashia talem barushia ketanima zate palushia karania raotosha deoni. Yes I decree and declare the siege is over. The pressure is lifted. The burden is gone. The sorrow is healed. Walk into favor. Walk into light. Walk into laughter. Walk into peace. This week carries good news. This season carries celebration. Your destiny is preserved. Joy has come and it will remain in the mighty name of Jesus Christ. Amen. Amen. Amen.
